create_PNGRawDataset: create a PNGRawDataset instance to load video object segmentation data from PNG image and mask folders
create_SA1BRawDataset: create a SA1BRawDataset instance to load SA-1B format video object segmentation data with JSON masks
create_JSONRawDataset: create a JSONRawDataset instance to load SA-V JSON annotated video object segmentation datasets
get_video_PNGRawDataset: get a VOSVideo and segment loader from a PNGRawDataset by index for frame-level access
review_VOSFrame_VOSVideo: review the VOSFrame and VOSVideo dataclasses that represent frames and videos in VOS datasets
